newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch.

text.p: * International Business Machines Corp is expected to report fourth quarter earnings per share of $3.88, compared to $3.09 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 167 Monday.
* NYNEX Corp is expected to report fourth quarter earnings per share of $0.94, compared to $0.88 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 50-3/8.
* Bell Atlantic Corp is expected to report fourth quarter earnings per share of $0.97, compared to $0.90 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 67-1/4.
* Chase Manhattan Corp is expected to report earnings per share of $1.88, compared to $1.73 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 92-7/8.
* Citicorp reported fourth quarter earnings per share of $1.97, compared to $1.72 last year. The First Call estimate was $1.95. The stock closed at 109.
* Dial Corp is expected to report fourth quarter earnings per share of $0.15, compared to $0.24 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 14-1/4.
* Bank of New York Co Inc is expected to report fourth quarter earnings per share of $0.61, compared to $0.56 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 35-7/8.
* USAir Group Inc is expected to report fourth quarter earnings per share of $0.16, compared to $0.54 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 24-1/2.
* Northwest Airlines Corp is expected to report fourth quarter earnings per share of $0.23, compared to $0.90 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 38-7/16.
